stem.text: Two blocks, X and Y, are on a horizontal frictionless surface. The mass of block Y is greater than that of block X. Block Y has a spring attached to its end.
The blocks are pushed together so that the spring is compressed between them and the blocks are held stationary as shown.

stem.alt: Block X and block Y on a horizontal surface, with a compressed spring between them, labelled frictionless surface and compressed spring, and the caption before release.

stem.text: When released, the blocks move in opposite directions.

A.text: After release, the kinetic energy of block X must equal the kinetic energy of block Y.

B.text: After release, the sum of the kinetic energies of the blocks is equal to zero.

C.text: The total energy of the spring and blocks immediately before release is zero.

D.text: The total energy of the spring and blocks is equal to the energy needed to bring the blocks together.
